svg.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'JetBrains Mono', 'Cascadia Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
svg.title: The life of a task
svg.desc: A task is analyzed, planned, and approved, then each ticket is built in order: tests first, then tries at the gate until one passes or a stop sends it to the advisor. When every ticket is a ready change, a reviewer reads the whole task. A question, a parked ticket, a send-back, or a stop at a checkpoint makes the task wait for you; when it runs again, it skips every finished step.

g.text: One at a time, in plan order

svg.text: asked you [the advisor is a person]
reported [passed, or the advisor says go on]
